modelAssumptions: This is a dated prospective planning comparison, not selected carrier, actual itinerary, service date, productive calendar observation, statistical confidence interval or operational promise.

One physical MX tractor, one US tractor and one53ft box form the modeled capacity cohort, not a fleet inferred from the user trip. Twenty-four available elapsed asset-days is explicit calendar capacity, not IMT300or ATRI268operating days divided by12.

MX120000km/year and US combined-average H12026 mileage are transferred as explicit prospective capacity proxies despite cohort/year/owned-profile limits. A single box's capacity is derived from the limiting cycle, not historical tractor km or closing carrier stock ratio.

US city-road mileage and time replace no authenticated Google review, exact72916terminal or PuenteIIIaccess. Source time is primary-publisher search readout only; highway class, restrictions, tolls and endpoint geometry remain unverified.

SAKBE and Travelmath clocks are assumed nominal driving, with independent fresh-driver ten-hour/24h blocks and public break structure. Two-hour loading, unload and handoff and fourteen-hour recovery reset are planning quantities, not measured averages. Weekly duty, actual hours and appointments are not certified.

TTI87min is historical complete crossing, not87min wait plus70min crossing. Add once to MX attached phase; road/crossing measurement overlap is assumed zero for sensitivity, not verified. Detached handoff2h is a separate modeled transfer, not implied by TTI. Southbound87min is explicitly symmetric hypothesis, never a northbound measurement relabelled as southbound.

Network7.61percent is PAMT uncompensated-empty metric. Equivalence to physical empty distance and transfer to MX/US are uncertain hypotheses, not observed return. Each tractor total=loaded/(1-e), not loaded*(1+e). After US delivery the same box stays with the US tractor to its modeled next pickup: inherit that physical US recovery movement only, not MX tractor's separate repositioning or7.61percent of combined box loaded distance. No full route return added on top.

Dedicated alternative uses full empty return of the same box. MX tractor stays committed at the border while US tractor completes roundtrip, then returns with that box; no immediate MX return without box plus simultaneous same-box recovery. Both crossings and both handoffs are serial and once on the box timeline.

Existing known fixed monthly components are allocated with the existing MAX(distance,time). Missing fixed/variable/company/border monetary components are outside this partial amount, never zero; whole CFU/CVU/D2D remains incomplete.

Effective monthly cycles cannot exceed either tractor distance capacity or any resource elapsed-day capacity. Box monthly km and days derive from those same cycles, not independent impossible capacities. No budget from ten-pair administrative scale is joined.
